headline: Prime SSE angle but small — glassy dawn log session or nothing.
today: That SSE swell lines up at a prime angle for Lido, which is rare, but it's only chest-high at 5s so temper the excitement. Dawn is glassy on a 3mph NNW before the ESE turns cross-on mid-morning. Get there early with the log and enjoy the clean peelers while they hold.

daysToWatch.note: Dawn WNW cross-off with 2-2.6ft on tap — cleanest morning of the stretch before SW onshore ramps to 17mph by evening. Early session worth it.
Bumps up toward 3ft but onshore start to finish, blowing 16mph by evening. More size, worse conditions.
